tbesh_html:
A man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, only mentioned at Num.3.24;
son of: Lael (H3815)
§ Eliasaph = "God has added"
1) a Gadite chief in the wilderness census
2) a head of the Gershonites

strongs_1890.strongs_def: Eljasaph, the name of two Israelites
strongs_1890.derivation: from H410 (אֵל) and H3254 (יָסַף); God (is) gatherer;
